name: FinancialGraph intraday causal input qualification
command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
root=/data/zyy/FinancialAD/gae-instability-v2
mkdir -p "$root/results"
run=$(mktemp -d "$root/results/intraday-qualification-20261128.XXXXXXXX")
/usr/bin/python3 -m jobs.intraday_qualification --raw "$root/data/raw/stocks_bars_1m.parquet" --out "$run"
cp "$run/qualification.json" "$run/progress.txt" "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/"
